name: Pika Bot
tagline: Watches the Pokemon Center US store for new drops
description: Keeps an eye on the official Pokemon Center storefront for collectors, so restocks, new trading-card sets and limited exclusives get flagged as they appear instead of after they sell out. It watches and reports; it does not check out or buy anything for you.
author: CardCaptain
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
